body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> Optoma introduced two new 720p home theater projector, the HD71 during CES 2008.
These latest projector bring accessibility to high-definition, big-screen video content. The Optoma HD71 combine amazing picture quality with extensive connectivity options for optimum performance.
The Optoma HD71 redefines vivid and vibrant and a high brightness level of 2400 lumens. The HD71 expands the versatility of the home theater projector, with its multitude of connectivity options.

The HD71 is an ideal crossover projector, perfect for both home and business uses. with the latest in multi-color processing capabilities, the HD71 delivers rich and deep textures with astonishing ease in non-light controlled environments.
